caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic or porcelain figurine of a dove perched on a rounded base. The dove is predominantly white with subtle gray shading throughout its wings, body, and tail, and it has an orange beak and small dark eye. The figurine's base is light-colored and decorated with simple painted elements: two red berries, a single green leaf, and a round yellow or golden mark. The surface is smooth and reflective, with soft shadowing to indicate the form. The background is plain and off-white, and the artist's signature "FRANKLIN SYRES" appears in light blue text near the bottom right corner.
title: Dove
